title: Do LP2 sections share a running key?
question: Does the source difference-IoC cross-section scan reveal an alignment that survives a complete-search control?
reader_question: Do two LP2 sections appear to share a running key?
summary: A planted shared key is detectable, but the strongest distinct LP2 section alignment is near the shuffled-search median. The saved source score disagrees with the pinned current formula at a tested alignment.
finding: The top distinct-section score is 6.0117 (pages 3–7 versus 33–39, shift 25, overlap 1120); 53 of 99 shuffled whole searches match or exceed it. The all-pair maximum 11.319 is a self-pair at lag one, not cross-section evidence. The source printout gives z=3.3 for another tested alignment, while pinned current code gives z=5.68; an older SD approximation is numerically consistent with 3.3, but the historical formula used is unverified.
limitations: The 36-pair shuffle comparison was specified after the self-pair maximum appeared and is exploratory. Shuffling section order does not model every plausible cipher. No plaintext or key is recovered.
next_steps: A shared-key claim needs a key-advance and section-alignment rule specified in advance, then a held-out plaintext prediction beyond a selected difference score.

scope.representation: Nine pinned relikd LP2 unsolved section rune streams; 12,956 runes total.
scope.procedure: Replay the source synthetic shared-key power example; scan all 45 unordered section pairs over shifts with at least 300 rune overlap, then 99 seeded full-search section-order shuffles. A clearly post-observation follow-up restricts to 36 distinct-section pairs and 99 separate full-search controls.
scope.parameters: GP29, 1,200-rune synthetic overlap, 300 source-style null draws, 99 all-pair shuffles and 99 distinct-pair follow-up shuffles.
scope.exclusions: Other transcriptions, key models, alternate boundaries or shifts, reverse transforms and full decryption.

review.reviewer: Independent winning-window arithmetic and shared-key cancellation check

reproduction.command: python experiments/records/leo-shared-key-differences/run.py --source-root REL --check && python experiments/records/leo-shared-key-differences/followup.py --source-root REL --check && python experiments/records/leo-shared-key-differences/check.py --source-root REL --source-test-root LEO && python experiments/records/leo-shared-key-differences/plot.py --check
reproduction.environment: Python 3.9+ with NumPy and Numba for full search; source transcriptions and Leo test receipts supplied as separately pinned checkouts.
